reviews.title: Great looks and performance
reviews.comment:
I got this for my Evolv X2 build and not only does the cooler/fans look fantastic, they were easy to mount, wire up and works great with the Phanteks LED and fan control software.
The unit is practically silent even when running hard.
reviews.author: FastRedPonyCar

reviews.title: It does it's job well
reviews.comment: It's great. Keeps my cpu cool 40 Celsius under medium load and around 50-60 degrees Celsius under heavy load. Overall great aesthetics and great performance i would recommend 👌
reviews.author: Jaxen walker

reviews.title: Easy Install and looks awesome!
reviews.comment: Easy installation! The D30 fans are clean when put together and they look great too. Mounting to the CPU (AM5) was also convenient. My Ryzen 9 9900x is staying well under 50°C idle without any issues. My only concern is that if you plan on using a NexLinq hub from Phanteks the wiring looks messy because there is no Linq6 connectors, so an adapter cable will be needed.
reviews.author: Bryan Murphy

reviews.title: Uses their own Fan connectors, doesn’t come with a controller.
reviews.comment: Bought this cooler to match my phanteks case. Rather disappointed to find out Phanteks uses their own connection cables (looks like NZXT’s). They do provide a conversion cable but uses motherboard lighting only. For the hefty price of the Glacier One, a controller should be included.
reviews.author: Patrick Ryner
